title: Uniqueness, Cramér-Rao Efficiency and Concentration Bounds for Quantum U-Statistics
summary: We study unbiased estimation of scalar-valued polynomial functionals of quantum states from independent copies. We establish an equivalence between the first-order marginal of a permutation-invariant finite-copy observable and the functional gradient. We then prove that, among unbiased permutation-invariant estimators, the quantum U-statistic is the unique extension to an arbitrary number of copies.
